keyEvents.text: Goal! Bradford City 1, Marine 0. Nick Powell (Bradford City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kayden Jackson.
Goal! Bradford City 2, Marine 0. Nick Powell (Bradford City) header from the centre of the box to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Adam Phillips.
Jack McIntyre (Marine) is shown the yellow card.
Goal! Bradford City 3, Marine 0. Adam Phillips (Bradford City) right footed shot from the right side of the box to the top left corner. Assisted by Macaulay Gillesphey.
George Lapslie (Bradford City) Substitution at 23'
Goal! Bradford City 4, Marine 0. Matthew Pennington (Bradford City) right footed shot from the right side of the six yard box to the bottom right corner.
Carlos Dos Santos (Marine) Substitution at 40'
George Kattah (Marine) Substitution at 41'
Finlay Sinclair-Smith (Marine) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Will Swan (Bradford City) Substitution at 45'
Isaac Abankwah (Marine) is shown the red card.
Penalty saved. George Lapslie (Bradford City) right footed shot saved in the centre of the goal by Jack McIntyre (Marine).
Jack Mcintyre (Marine) Penalty - Saved at 54'
Goal! Bradford City 5, Marine 0. Will Swan (Bradford City) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the centre of the goal. Assisted by Kayden Jackson.
Stephen Humphrys (Bradford City) Substitution at 59'
Hayden Matthews (Bradford City) Substitution at 59'
Reece Welch (Bradford City) Substitution at 59'
James Potter (Marine) Substitution at 60'
Arjan Raikhy (Marine) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Goal! Bradford City 6, Marine 0. George Lapslie (Bradford City) right footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom left corner. Assisted by Will Swan.
Harry Huby (Marine) Substitution at 76'
Conor McAleny (Marine) Substitution at 76'
